title: Repeated order lines
spec: Implement totals(lines), where lines is a list of (product_id, quantity), product_id is a string and quantity is a non-negative integer. Return a dictionary summing all quantities per product, including repeated products. Empty input returns an empty dictionary.
target_defect: Repeated product quantities overwrite one another instead of being added.
author_rationale: The change constructs a product-to-quantity result from order lines.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
